items.title: Normative Instruction Nº 1 of 21 January 2016
items.description:
This is to notify that the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Food Supply (MAPA) issued Normative Instruction Nº 1 of 21 January 2016, published in the "Diário Oficial da União" (Federal Official Journal) of 22 January 2016, section 1, to amend the phytosanitary requirements for the importation into Brazil of Prunus persica (peach) according to country of destination and origin, for MERCOSUR States Parties, notified as G/SPS/N/BRA/208 from 22 September 2006.
http://members.wto.org/crnattachments/2016/SPS/BRA/16_0378_00_x.pdf

items.title: "Portaria" nº 5, from 18 January 2016
items.description: This is to inform that the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Food Supply (MAPA), through "Portaria" Nº 5, from 18 January 2016, submits to public consultation the draft of Normative Instruction that approves the establishment of phytosanitary import requirements for growing media used on plant propagation.
